name: products-delete
description: A product deletion skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to move one or more products under a specified site language to the recycle bin and supports batch deletion by product ID list.

language.description: Required. Enabled site language. It must be selected from `languages-get` after user confirmation. Automatic selection or system inference is not allowed.

id_list.description: Required. Product ID list, up to 100 items. Matching products will be moved to the recycle bin.

confirmation.description: Required. Records the explicit user approval shown before moving products to the recycle bin.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact product IDs.

summary.description: Required confirmation summary that restates the language and exact product IDs shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

notes: This delete action moves products to the recycle bin instead of permanently removing them.
If a product is deleted by mistake, it can be restored from the recycle bin.
